units.source_text: 她甚至谈了这样一件事情：在这里接受第一次检查的时候，她以为跟雏妓时一样，只把胸部敞开，所以被人家取笑，后来她竟哭了起来。

en.t: She even told him about this: when she had her first examination here, she thought it would be the same as when she had been a young apprentice, and only opened her robe at the chest, so people laughed at her, and afterward she actually began to cry.

units.source_text: 她还如实地回答了岛村的询问。

en.t: She also answered Shimamura's questions honestly.
